coverage_override.reason: The two selectable activation branches are separate because each has an independent per-turn flag; the GY Fusion Summon is the third effect. Corrupted source bullet glyphs do not add clauses.

effects.printed_clause: Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Roar" per turn): Add 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Branch 1 is available only while its id turn flag is unused and a Red-Eyes monster can be searched; the committed option registers that flag, then resolution adds and reveals one matching Deck monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Red-Eyes Deck search adds an archetypal card to hand and confirms it.

effects.printed_clause: Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Roar" per turn): Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip 1 Level 4 or lower "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY to it.
effects.lua_implementation: Branch 2 uses the independent id+100 turn flag, targets either player's face-up monster, selects a Level 4 or lower Red-Eyes monster from hand, Deck, or Necrovalley-valid GY, then equips it with a recipient-specific equip limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Red-Eyes effect targets a face-up recipient, equips a selected monster with Duel.Equip, and installs its equip limit.

effects.printed_clause: You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Fiend Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by using Monster Cards in your hand or field as Fusion Material. You can only use this effect of "Red-Eyes Roar" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY Ignition effect with id+200 banishes this card as cost, then builds Duel.GetFusionMaterial and merges eligible face-up original Monster Cards from the controller's Spell/Trap Zone. It filters the three printed Fusion races, selects and sends material with Fusion reasons, Special Summons, completes the procedure, and preserves Chain Material support.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Fusion effect explicitly merges eligible face-up original Monster Cards from LOCATION_SZONE into the normal Fusion material group.
Official effect performs the standard hand/field Fusion selection, sends materials with Fusion reasons, Special Summons, and completes the procedure.

effects.issue: Fixed: the hand-or-field material pool now includes eligible face-up Monster Cards occupying the controller's Spell/Trap Zone.
